title: education/attendance
description: One row per pupil per recorded teaching session. Session-by-session attendance. This is a sample of sessions rather than every one of them, which keeps the table a sensible size while still supporting a meaningful attendance rate per enrolment.

enrollment_id.description: Which pupil-on-which-course this record is for. Counting present rows against total rows per enrolment gives that enrolment's attendance rate.

session_date.description: Date of the session. Always a weekday during term time -- Spanish schools do not teach at weekends or through July and August.

status.description: Whether the pupil attended. 'excused' covers an absence the school accepted in advance, which is counted separately from an unexplained one in Spanish attendance reporting.

minutes_late.description: How late the pupil arrived, zero unless the status is 'late'. Typically between 5 and 35 minutes when it is not.
